question: Why did review scores for watches/gifts (relogios_presentes) fall in 2018-01?

change.metric: average review score of reviewed orders, by order purchase date

causes.summary: Customers rated the products lower: scores fell even on orders delivered on time.

statements.text: Average review score of orders delivered on time: 1.9333 in the window against 4.2504 in the baseline (-54.5%).
Average review score: 1.8769 in the window against 3.9975 in the baseline (-53.0%).
The measurements are consistent with: Customers rated the products lower: scores fell even on orders delivered on time.

evidence.finding: Average review score of orders delivered on time: 1.9333 in the window against 4.2504 in the baseline (-54.5%).
Average review score: 1.8769 in the window against 3.9975 in the baseline (-53.0%).

next_checks: Read the review comments for the window and check the products behind them.

ruled_out.why: H1: The measure did not move as the explanation predicts: Average days from purchase to delivery of reviewed orders: 12.8825 in the window against 13.6991 in the baseline (-6.0%).
H3: The measure did not move as the explanation predicts: Largest single seller's share of low-score (1-2) reviews: 0.2714 in the window against 0.3456 in the baseline (-21.5%).
H4: The measure did not move as the explanation predicts: Share of orders with duplicate or missing review scores: 0.0 in the window against 0.0013 in the baseline (-100.0%).

limitations: Only delivery timing, on-time review scores, seller concentration and review-record quality were tested; review comment text and product details were not read.
Sample mode: model replies come from the recorded per-call cache and data from the local DuckDB sample; agents, queries and the loop run for real.
